failure_story: We treated Adobe as a subscription compounder on FY2025 owner cash of $23.07 per share, with contract base value $656 per share versus about $235 spot and Lawrence synthesis near 32% per year. The failure path was competitive, not solvency: generative-AI alternatives eroded Creative Cloud net seat additions faster than Firefly monetization offset, RPO growth lagged revenue for two consecutive quarters, and Digital Media ARPU stalled as individual-tier pricing capped while Experience Cloud deals slowed with marketing-budget cuts. Trailing free cash flow per share drifted toward the contract falsifier below $18, buybacks slowed as debt stayed elevated after the 2025 note offering, and the market re-rated Adobe from pricing-power compounder to AI-disrupted legacy software. Selling multiples compressed from the 25× Lawrence exit assumption toward the high teens; hold-period return landed near the bear Lawrence envelope and far below the synthesis base case. Equity de-rating on a partial-dhando name, not distress, was the primary capital-loss path.
